svg.text: One shared runner. Every background job records itself, cannot overlap, and appears on one admin page.
built first, as one vertical slice from the database up to the page
the page sees jobs in flight
which jobs exist, enabled or not
click a run for step timings
and only then does anything actually run
AND THEN TWO MORE PROJECTS PLUGGED INTO IT
each one is simply another job entering through the same runner

When I built the problem health check job I wrote no dashboard code for it at all. It runs through the runner, so it appeared on /admin/crons on its own. That is the moment the foundation paid for itself.
And the web layer never launches a program: the rerun button only writes a row, and a separate trusted worker with a fixed list of jobs it will accept is what actually runs anything.
